budget_items.topic: Small bridge grant for Flat Hill Rd culvert
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The town was awarded a grant to fund the Flat Hill Rd culvert project.
budget_items.quote: the town has been awarded a $500,000 small bridge grant to fund the flat hill rd culvert project.

budget_items.topic: Assessor's budget and prior-year invoice in potential fall Special Town Meeting articles
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Potential warrant articles include additional assessor's budget funding for cyclical data inspections and a prior year FY21 invoice.
budget_items.quote: additional funding for assessor's budget for cyclical data inspections estimated at $35,000, and a prior year invoice from fy21.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Road materials for FY23 rose against the FY20 contract.
budget_items.quote: road materials for fy23 has increased between 20-40 percent from the fy20 contract.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The town will receive more state aid than originally anticipated after the state passed its budget.
budget_items.quote: the town will receive $54,417 more in state aid than originally anticipated.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The one bid received for the town beach building project was much higher than expected, and the plan may change.
budget_items.quote: the town has received one bid on the town beach building project, and it was much higher than expected.

budget_items.topic: EPA funding for underground gas tank and soil removal
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The EPA will fund removal of underground gas tanks and hazardous soil at 925 Massachusetts Ave; prior owners have one year to take ownership and pay back taxes.
budget_items.quote: ms. lemieux reported that the epa will fund the safe removal of underground gas tanks, and hazardous soil from 925 massachusetts ave.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Loofah Farms will seek tax incentives from the town for agricultural business at 361 Massachusetts Ave.
budget_items.quote: the farm will seek tax incentives from the town.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Discussion that the town must know a project's cost before determining how much can be borrowed under fiscal policy; no figure printed.
budget_items.quote: ms. brochu suggested the town would need to know how much money a project would cost in order to determine how much money could be borrowed.
